32293-for-every-man-a-reason.title: For Every Man A Reason
32293-for-every-man-a-reason.creator: Unknown
32293-for-every-man-a-reason.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Aron and Martha, his wife, took their time. They had an abundance of that elusive quantity known as time at this lonely outpost. The trail up to the station was rough, with rocks and weeds tearing at them. Aron resolved that that would be one of his first projects, to put in a good path to the meadow where the rocket would come for them--five years from now.

34173-canadian-wilds-tells-about-the-hud.title: Trapping, Etc.
34173-canadian-wilds-tells-about-the-hud.creator: Martin Hunter
34173-canadian-wilds-tells-about-the-hud.description: A book by Martin Hunter. My service in the employ of the Great Fur Company extended from Labrador in the East to Fort William on Lake Superior in the West and from the valley of the St. Lawrence in the South to the headwaters of its feeders in the North.

arxiv-2010-13392.title: Containing Future Epidemics with Trustworthy Federated Systems for Ubiquitous Warning and Response
arxiv-2010-13392.creator: Dick Carrillo, Lam Duc Nguyen, Pedro H. J. Nardelli, Evangelos Pournaras, Plinio Morita, Demóstenes Z. Rodríguez, Merim Dzaferagic, Harun Siljak, Alexander Jung, Laurent Hébert-Dufresne, Irene Macaluso, Mehar Ullah, Gustavo Fraidenraich, Petar Popovski
arxiv-2010-13392.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a global digital platform to avoid and combat epidemics by providing relevant real-time information to support selective lockdowns. It leverages the pervasiveness of wireless connectivity while being trustworthy and secure. The proposed system is conceptualized to be decentralized yet federated, based on ubiquitous public systems and active citizen participation.

arxiv-2108-07636.title: Accounting for shared covariates in semi-parametric Bayesian additive regression trees
arxiv-2108-07636.creator: Estevão B. Prado, Andrew C. Parnell, Keefe Murphy, Nathan McJames, Ann O’Shea, Rafael A. Moral
arxiv-2108-07636.description: Abstract We propose some extensions to semi-parametric models based on Bayesian additive regression trees (BART). In the semi-parametric BART paradigm, the response variable is approximated by a linear predictor and a BART model, where the linear component is responsible for estimating the main effects and BART accounts for non-specified interactions and non-linearities.

arxiv-2111-00626.title: Intrusion Detection using Spatial-Temporal features based on Riemannian Manifold Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2111-00626.creator: Amardeep Singh, Julian Jang-Jaccard
arxiv-2111-00626.description: Abstract Network traffic data is combination of different data bytes packet under different network protocols. These traffic packets have complex time-varying non-linear relationships. Existing state of the art method rise up to this challenge by fusing features into multiple subset based on correlations and using hybrid classification techniques that extract spatial and temporal characteristics.

arxiv-2204-01736.title: Tracking Urbanization in Developing Regions with Remote Sensing Spatial-Temporal Super-Resolution
arxiv-2204-01736.creator: Yutong He, William Zhang, Chenlin Meng
arxiv-2204-01736.description: Abstract Automated tracking of urban development in areas where construction information is not available became possible with recent advancements in machine learning and remote sensing. Unfortunately, these solutions perform best on high-resolution imagery, which is expensive to acquire and infrequently available, making it difficult to scale over long time spans and across large geographies.

arxiv-2304-05650.title: Adaptive asymptotic solutions of inflationary models in the Hamilton-Jacobi formalism: Application to T-models
arxiv-2304-05650.creator: Elena Medina, and Gabriel Álvarez
arxiv-2304-05650.description: Abstract We develop a method to compute the slow-roll expansion for the Hubble parameter in inflationary models in a flat Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker spacetime that is applicable to a wide class of potentials including monomial, polynomial, or rational functions of the inflaton, as well as polynomial or rational functions of the exponential of the inflaton.

arxiv-2306-17145.title: Nucleosynthesis of light nuclei and hypernuclei in central Au+Au collisions at s N ​ N \sqrt{s_{NN}} =3 GeV
arxiv-2306-17145.creator: N. Buyukcizmeci 1 , T. Reichert 2,3,4 , A.S. Botvina 2,3 , M. Bleicher 2,3,5
arxiv-2306-17145.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by N. Buyukcizmeci 1 , T. Reichert 2,3,4 , A.S. Botvina 2,3 , M. Bleicher 2,3,5. We analyze the experimental data on nuclei and hypernuclei yields recently obtained by the STAR collaboration. The hybrid dynamical and statistical approaches which have been developed previously are able to describe the experimental data reasonably. We discuss the intriguing difference between the yields of normal nuclei and hypernuclei which may be related to the properties of hypermatter at subnuclear densities. New (hyper-)nuclei could be detected via particle correlations.

arxiv-2510-10709.creator: Kyla Chasalow, Skyler Wu, Susan Murphy
arxiv-2510-10709.description: Abstract Missing data in online reinforcement learning (RL) poses challenges compared to missing data in standard tabular data or in offline policy learning. The need to impute and act at each time step means that imputation cannot be put off until enough data exist to produce stable imputation models.

arxiv-2511-03111.creator: Justin Swain, Giordano Tierra
arxiv-2511-03111.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The Cahn-Hilliard equation [ 2 , 13 , 12 ] is a physical model for phase separation with applications in physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering such as the spinodal decomposition, tumor growth [ 43 ] , multi-phase fluid flows [ 33 ] , vesicle membrane deformation [ 27 ] , and diblock copolymers [ 15 ] .

arxiv-2512-11902.title: Mirror Mode in Fire Emblem: Beating Players at their own Game with Imitation and Reinforcement Learning Conference: LIACS; 2025; Leiden
arxiv-2512-11902.creator: Yanna Elizabeth Smid, Peter van der Putten, Aske Plaat
arxiv-2512-11902.description: Abstract . Enemy strategies in turn-based games should be surprising and unpredictable. This study introduces Mirror Mode, a new game mode where the enemy AI mimics the personal strategy of a player to challenge them to keep changing their gameplay.

pmc-11436661.creator: Aleksander Kolman, Tomasz Pedzinski, Anna Lewandowska-Andralojc
pmc-11436661.description: Meta-tetra(hydroxyphenyl)chlorin (m-THPC) is among the most potent photosensitizers, known for its high singlet oxygen generation efficiency. However, its clinical effectiveness in photodynamic therapy (PDT) is compromised by its propensity to aggregate in aqueous solutions, adversely affecting its photophysical properties and therapeutic potential.

pmc-11486842.title: Impact of California's naloxone co‐prescription law on emergency department visits, 30‐day mortality, and prescription patterns
pmc-11486842.creator: Ali Ghobadi, Michael Hanna, Stephanie Tovar, Duy H Do, Lewei Duan, Ming‐Sum Lee, Elizabeth A Samuels, Corey S Davis, Adam L Sharp
pmc-11486842.description: ObjectiveOpioid overdose is a public health epidemic adversely impacting individuals and communities. To combat this, California passed a law mandating that prescribers offer a naloxone prescription in certain circumstances. Our objective was to evaluate associations with California's naloxone prescription mandate and emergency department (ED) overdose visits/hospitalizations, opioid and naloxone prescribing, and 30‐day mortality.

It is composed of the infundibular part, the perimembranous part, and the muscular part.

pmc-11692733.title: ALZHEIMER’S DIAGNOSIS AND CARE BY RACIAL AND ETHNIC GROUP IN THE MEDICARE POPULATION
pmc-11692733.creator: Margaret Hoyt, Melissa Bailey-Taylor, Julie Chandler, Joseph Johnston
pmc-11692733.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Little is known about differences in healthcare resource utilization (HCRU) among racial/ethnic groups with Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Our study aims to address this gap with an incident AD cohort in Medicare claims data. We identified Medicare patients ≥65 years old with a first (index) AD code (ICD-10 G30*) or medication (galantamine, rivastigmine, donepezil, or memantine) in 2018 or 2019 who were continuously enrolled (gap < 45 days) one year pre- and post-index.

pmc-12705089.title: Real-World Outcomes of 3-Month Olfactory Training on Post-COVID-19 Parosmia
pmc-12705089.creator: Xinni Xu, Kristóf Peter Ludányi, Jerry Hadi Juratli, Fruzsina Németh, Dávid Nagy, Helga Kraxner, Thomas Hummel
pmc-12705089.description: IntroductionPost-COVID-19 parosmia can be protracted and psychologically distressing. The effect of olfactory training (OT) on parosmia is still unclear. The primary objective was to investigate the effect of 3 months of OT on COVID-19-related parosmia. The secondary objectives were to study whether improvement in olfactory quantitative function and compliance to OT influenced improvement in parosmia.

pmc-12883042.title: Predicting the Risk of Opioid-induced Respiratory Depression Using ChatGPT-4o and Machine Learning Techniques
pmc-12883042.creator: Mohammad Meshkini, Sayed Masoud Hosseini, Peyman Erfan Talab Evini, Mitra Rahimi, Babak Mostafazadeh, Pooya Eini, Nahal Babaeian Amini, Amirhossein Faghihi, Farhad Esmailsorkh, Sajede Karimi, Mohammad Asadi, Hadi Jalilvand, Nasibeh Rady Raz, Iman Alidadyani, Hadi Jafari, Faraz Zandiyeh, Kiandokht Kh
pmc-12883042.description: Introduction:Opioid-induced respiratory depression is a life-threatening complication of opioid overdose. This study aimed to develop a model for predicting the risk of respiratory depression following opioid overdose using ChatGPT-4o.Methods:A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted on 2,005 patients admitted following opioid overdose at Loghman Hakim Hospital, Tehran, Iran, from February 2021 to February 2024.

pmc-13070328.creator: Qian Zhang, Shan Wang, Jiajia Zhang, Tianyu Chu, Xian Chen, Linlin Ma, Hui Zhou, Yibo Wu, Dewu Xu, Kai Jiang
pmc-13070328.description: PurposeThis study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of a supportive intervention program designed based on Existence-Relatedness-Growth theory and the Supportive Care Needs Framework in reducing unmet needs among breast cancer patients and their spouse caregivers.Patients and MethodsThis study was a two-arm, single-blind randomized controlled trial.

pmc-13158592.title: Chronotype-aligned exercise timing in middle-aged adults at cardiometabolic risk: a randomised controlled trial
pmc-13158592.creator: Arsalan Tariq, Mohammed Harris Khalid, Muhammad Ammar
pmc-13158592.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo investigate whether aligning exercise timing with chronotype enhances cardiometabolic and sleep-related benefits in sedentary adults with cardiovascular risk factors.MethodsIn this 12-week randomised controlled trial conducted in Lahore, Pakistan (January–June 2025), 150 sedentary adults (aged 40–60) with at least one cardiovascular risk factor were recruited and categorised as morning-type or evening-type using the Morningness-Eveningness Questionnaire and validated by 48 hour core body temperature monitoring.

pmc-13205771.creator: Hyun-Kyung Sung, Yongtaek Oh, Mikyung Kim, Eun-Jin Kim, Ju-Hee Lee, Yejin Han, Namin Shin
pmc-13205771.description: Background: Virtual reality (VR) simulations provide immersive, interactive learning environments that can support clinical skill development in medical education. However, evidence for its application in Korean medical education remains limited. This pilot study aimed to develop and evaluate HaniE-VR1, a 360° VR simulation program designed to teach ultrasound-guided pharmacopuncture.

pmc-13515285.creator: Hui Wang, Qihuan Zhao, Bo Wang, Chengquan Du, Jingjing Wang, Liang Zhang, Fuxiang Bao
pmc-13515285.description: Clostridium perfringens is a major livestock pathogen responsible for histotoxic diseases and intestinal infections, posing serious threats to public health and the poultry and breeding industry. Overreliance on antibiotics has driven the emergence of drug-resistant strains and disruption of gut microbiota homeostasis, underscoring the urgent need for alternative control strategies.

pmc-13604516.title: Molecular Classifications and Candidate Biomarkers for Personalizing BCG Therapy in Non-Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer
pmc-13604516.creator: Airat Bilyalov, Andrey Kotov, Natalia Bodunova, Maxim Zingerenko, Igor Khatkov, Ludmila Zhukova
pmc-13604516.description: Intravesical Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) remains the standard adjuvant treatment for intermediate- and high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer. However, 30–50% of patients fail to respond or experience recurrence within two years, while clinical and pathological risk models have limited accuracy in predicting individual response.

pmc-13651037.title: Evaluating the role of biotic and abiotic factors in hardwood tree development in the Central Hardwood Region (CHR)
pmc-13651037.creator: Shaneka S. Lawson, Juan P. Frene, Niall D. Lue Sue
pmc-13651037.description: BackgroundHardwood tree growth and development are influenced by the interplay between soil microbiota and tree physiology. Though unclear mechanistically, microbial community composition is associated with tree growth. We investigated how soil chemistry and prokaryotic communities impacted Quercus rubra (red oak) and Juglans nigra (black walnut) growth across three plantations in Indiana and Michigan.
